name: Yawgmoth
title: The Father of Machines
role: Thran physician and ruler of Phyrexia
summary: A Thran physician whose ambition transformed an artificial plane into the center of Phyrexian power.
biography: Yawgmoth entered the Thran capital of Halcyon during a medical crisis. His knowledge and political maneuvering helped him acquire influence, even as his increasingly ruthless experiments threatened the civilization.
The planeswalker Dyfed introduced him to the artificial plane of Phyrexia. Yawgmoth did not originally create that plane; he took control of it and reshaped its inhabitants according to his vision.
Phyrexia became a threat to Dominaria across thousands of years, from the influence of Gix during the Brothers’ War to the invasion opposed by Urza and the Weatherlight crew.

Yawgmoth's entry into Halcyon depended on a medical emergency and on Rebbec's hope that he could help Glacian. His access to patients and public authority let a physician present coercive control as a necessary response to the consequences of powerstone technology.

The implanting of two broken powerstone halves in Glacian's body provides a specific example of the danger behind Yawgmoth's claims. Official accounts describe the fragments draining the inventor's life instead of restoring it; this episode precedes their later use to seal the gateway to Phyrexia.

The artificial plane Dyfed revealed to Yawgmoth already existed before he encountered it. His later transformation of Phyrexia into a society organized around his vision should be distinguished from its original creation and from the much later return of his influence through Gix and other agents.

featuredCard.significance: Yawgmoth before his transformation into the ruler of Phyrexia.
